_fixture.semantic: The definition: name=question, options[].optionName=labels (optionHash when supplied matches the decrypted vote's selectedOptions SHA256 entries), selectableOptionsCount=multi-select bound (1 = single choice), contextInfo carries mentions/quote. messageContextInfo.messageSecret is THE decryption prerequisite for pollUpdateMessage votes — it must be cached at creation capture; votes on a poll whose creation the bridge missed are permanently undecryptable (source key cannot be invented). No anonymity flag exists in this proto: WhatsApp polls are always identified-voter protocol-wise, but votes stay encrypted until decrypted per-voter.
